book.title: Pwoo ɗe Pool ran nen Afisus Mo

content: Mo Ɓàl Mun Kǝ Fwooshin Kristi
Wen ɗe an a shishoot mbǝ sǝm Daa. Wen kǝn ɗang pǝ wun, mbǝkǝ wu mwaan-mwaan ɗe mo lapshak kǝ petpee ɗe Naan wur kǝ pǝrep wun mbǝ nǝ.
Wu sham kǝ káa fuu mo koo pǝranyi. Wu cìn mbii mo nɗǝǝn ɗyen, kǝ wun gung zak. Wu kám wal fuu mo agaak, kǝ nwun fwangshak zak.
Wu gung, kǝ nwun tap ɗe kǝ ɓalkaa ɗe Riin wur shin nwun, shi tongryang ɗe nǝ ɓàl wun ashak.
Shin nǝ a mǝndong, kǝ Riin nǝ mǝndong ɓejee. Kaaɗi mo kǝ pǝrep wun, nɗǝǝn canciin mǝndong nkaa mbii ɗe mo kǝ pet wun mbǝ nǝ.
Daa a mǝndong, shinzeen nǝ a mǝndong, baptisma nǝ a mǝndong,
Naan a mǝndong, ɗewur a puun fun jir. Wur met mbii mo jir, kǝ a wur cìn ɗak nɗǝǝn mun jir, kǝ a wur nɗǝǝn mun jir zak.
Ɗang koo a weyi nɗǝǝn mun, ɓe wur kǝ lap ɗeret nciit-nciit kǝ zuum kǝ Kristi.
Kaaɗe mo kǝ ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan sǝ nǝnee,

content.text: ɗeyiyak mo ɗes ashak kǝ wur,
kǝ wur shin zuum ngurum mo zak.>>

content: Yaksǝ, ɓe nǝnee, <<wur kaa aɗeng >> ɓe shii mǝnǝ a mii? Shii mǝnǝ nee, nshee ɓe wur sham nɗǝǝn jurum kǝ peekyes kǝ yil ɗesǝ.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, gwar ɗe gyet wur sham, a wur a gwar ɗewur kaa aɗeng-ɗeng a kǝkyeen ɗengnaan mo, mbǝkǝ wur gam ɗeng kǝ yil jir.

A wur shìn zuum ngurum mbǝkǝ npak mo ɗee ɗi, a jeplep mo, kǝ npak mo ɗee a nensatpwoo Naan mo, kǝ npak mo ɗee ɗi a nenkop pwoo Naan mo, kǝ npak mo ɗee ɗi a Pasto mo, kǝ npak mo ɗee ɗi a nenkám kam mo zak.
Wur shin zuum ɗesǝ mo, a mbǝkǝ nǝ ɗak nen Naan mo ɗe, mbǝ ɓamshak, kǝ mbǝkǝ mo ɗyik fwoshik kǝ Kristi ɗi.
Nǝ aasǝ, ɓe mun jir, mun nyool mu ɗee a ɗemǝndong nɗǝǝn shinzeen fun, kǝ man fun ɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn Làa Naan. Mun nyool mu ɗee a nen ɗe kǝ man mo, Mbǝkǝ mun wul mbǝ gam ɗeɗes mǝ Kristi.
Ɓe baa mu kuɗi a jep ɗeɗyeen mo kas mǝnǝ, ɗe mo nnum mun shindǝm sǝ, Mbǝkǝ mo mang mun pán, shi koo a kyaan kám ɗeɗangyi kas. Mo a nenseen mo ɗe mo a korong mbǝ ɓǝrǝm ɗung.
Akoppee mǝnǝ nǝ ret kǝ mun sat zeen nǝ nɗǝǝn nwal. Nǝ ret kǝ mun wurang nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir, nɗǝǝn Kristi ɗewur a káa fun.

A mbǝ wur, ɗangɓe koo a ɓeep ɗeɗangyi, mo shini-shini, mo tap ɓàl ashak, kǝ koo a peeɓal ɗeɗangyi, nǝ katɓal a nɗǝǝn wur. Katɗang koo a ɓeep ɗeɗangyi nǝ kǝ cìn ɗak war rǝret, ɓe fwoshik nǝ nwurang, kǝ nǝ ɗyik set ɗi nɗǝǝn nwal zak.
Seen Ɗepwoo nƊǝǝn Kristi
nƊǝǝn sǝm Daa, ɓe nkǝn satpwoo wun shiɓal nǝ, taji wu sat a ntong kaa nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas sǝ, ɗe pan mo a ɗebuu.
Pan ɗe nɗǝǝn pǝtuup mo, nǝ a mǝ peenkwoo, baa mo kǝ mee lǝɓet nɗǝǝn seen ɗe Naan shin kas, mbǝɗe baa mo kǝ mee man kas, kǝ mo ɗee a nencinshik mo.
Baa mo kuɗi kǝ naashweep kǝ mee mbii kas. Mo fes shínkáa fur mo mbǝ cìn mbii ɗebish mo, kǝ moo coor mbǝ cìn koo a mbii ɗebish ɗeɗangyi. Baa moo kǝ mee yaasut kas.
Amma baa a mbii ɗe wun wu kám pee Kristi ɗe mǝnǝ kas!
Mo sat nnǝ, wuu ten wu kǝlǝng pwoo nkaa wur, kǝ mmoo kám nwun zeen ɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn Jesu.
Wu shwat suk ɗesǝǝr nǝ mo wu baa kǝ mo aku, ɗe dǝ moo nnum wun nɗǝǝn coor mǝ nan sǝ.
Nǝ a tǝng kǝ npǝtuup fuu mo kǝ pan fuu mo ɗee a ɗepwoo,
Kǝzak, nǝ a tǝng kǝ wu jwal fwoshik ɗepwoo nǝ mo, ɗe Naan wur ɗak mǝnǝ shikaa fin sǝ, kǝ nǝ woo káa nnǝ agaak nɗǝǝn seen ɗe nǝ azeen-nzeen ɗe nǝ a ɗeret kǝ ɗeɓang.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, wu baa kǝ ɗung nɗǝǝn wun, kǝ koo a weyi ɓe wur sat azeen ngǝnǝǝn wur ɓejee ɗak. Mbǝɗe mun a ɗemǝndong kǝ shak nɗǝǝn Kristi.
Katɗang wu langtuup, ɓe taji wu cìn shikbish kas. Taji puus shamru, ɓe wun ɗe nkaa langtuup kas.
Taji wu shínpee ngujwaan kas.
Ngwe ɗe wur cìn wat, ɓe taji wur baa cìn ɗe kas, ɗangɓe nǝ ret kǝ wur cìn ɗak ɗeret shi sar wur, mbǝkǝ wur mak cin mee mbii ɗe nen ɗe mo mɓut njeel
Taji pwoo ɗebish mo put nɗǝǝn pwoo fuu mo kas, ɗangɓe ɗang a mbii ɗeret mo, ɗe mon nɗyik wun, kaaɗi nǝ tap ret kǝ pee nǝ sǝ. Mbǝkǝ nǝ jì ɗe kǝ ɗeret nen ɗe moo kǝlǝng nǝ.
Taji wu wàt pǝtuup nRiin Ɗeɓang mǝ Naan kas, wur ɗe a wur ɗee a langtǝng nǝ, wuu ɗee a ɗe fufwang mbǝ parpuus ɗe mon mɓam wun.
Wu pwat kǝ pwoo ɗeɗeet mo, kǝ ciishak, kǝ tuup, kǝ ɓutbish, kǝ fǝlǝppee ashak kǝ cìn nyang mo jir.
Ɗang nǝ ret kǝ nwun naajeel shak, kǝ nwun ɓam shak, kǝ nwun fwo ɗi nshak, kaaɗi Naan wur fwo ɗi nwun nɗǝǝn Kristi sǝ.
